faq.question: Can I really just take a casual selfie against any messy wall?
faq.answer: Yes, 100%! You don't need a white backdrop, studio lights, or fancy camera equipment. Take a selfie on your phone or webcam from your couch. Our AI automatically detects you, eliminates all background clutter, levels out shadows, and swaps in the exact solid consular backdrop required by your destination country.

faq.question: What if my selfie is tilted, uncentered, or not aligned?
faq.answer: Don't worry at all. Our 22-point biometric engine automatically detects your eye baseline, auto-straightens slight head tilt, centers your facial oval, and scales your head height to the exact official millimeter ratio (e.g. 50–69% for US, 70–80% for UK/EU).

faq.question: Do I need to sign up or provide my personal passport details?
faq.answer: No. We believe in total privacy. Zero account creation, zero passwords, and zero personal identity information requested. We only process your photo file, generate your 600 DPI downloads, and automatically purge all files from our servers within 24 hours under TLS 1.3 encryption.

faq.question: Why should I use ApprovaVisa instead of visiting a pharmacy or studio?
faq.answer: ApprovaVisa lets you prepare a passport or visa photo from home and download a digital file or printable sheet. Check the current instructions from the receiving authority before submitting your photo.

faq.question: Will my photo be accepted by the embassy or passport agency?
faq.answer: Only the receiving embassy or passport authority can decide whether to accept a photo. Our automated checks help you prepare it against published requirements; review the rules for your exact application route before submitting.

faq.question: What formats do I receive after processing?
faq.answer: You receive a single ultra-high-resolution 600 DPI digital JPEG (calibrated to exact destination millimeter requirements for online consular portal upload) plus a tiled 4×6 inch (10×15 cm) print-ready sheet with cut guides for easy printing at home or any local print kiosk.

faq.question: How fast is delivery?
faq.answer: Instant! The moment payment is confirmed, your clean, unwatermarked 600 DPI files are unlocked immediately on screen for one-click download, and can optionally be emailed directly to your inbox.
